topic: 住所与生活环境 · Independent new scenario: reporting and resolving a home repair
grammarFocus: there be；可数与不可数名词；some / any；地点介词复习。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: A Leaky Day at Maple Court
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思试题）。请先通读短文，注意there be句型、可数与不可数名词、some/any以及地点介词。然后完成8道阅读题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A. Lin Wei lives in a small flat at Maple Court. It is on the second floor. There is a kitchen, a living room, one bedroom and a bathroom. There are two windows in the living room. The flat is old but quiet. Lin Wei likes it.

B. On Monday morning, Lin Wei sees water under the kitchen sink. There is a lot of water on the floor. She puts a bowl under the sink. Then she calls the building office. A man answers the phone. "Good morning. Maple Court office. How can I help you?" Lin Wei says, "There is water under my sink. Can you send a plumber?" The man says, "Yes. Is there any water near the electric socket?" Lin Wei looks. "No, there isn't any water there. But there is some water near the fridge." The man says, "OK. Please don't use the kitchen. A plumber can come at 2 p.m."

C. At 2 p.m., a plumber comes. His name is Tom. He looks at the sink. "There is a small hole in the pipe," he says. "There isn't any problem with the tap." Tom works for thirty minutes. He puts a new pipe under the sink. Then he cleans the floor. Lin Wei asks, "Is there any water now?" Tom says, "No, there isn't. The floor is dry." Lin Wei says, "Thank you." Tom says, "You're welcome. Please call us again if there is any problem."

questions.prompt: Which floor is Lin Wei's flat on?
questions.explanation: 原文明确说“It is on the second floor.”，所以答案是second floor。
questions.evidence: It is on the second floor.

questions.prompt: How many windows are there in the living room?
questions.explanation: 原文说“There are two windows in the living room.”，数字是two。
questions.evidence: There are two windows in the living room.

questions.prompt: What does Lin Wei first notice under the kitchen sink on Monday morning?
questions.explanation: 她最先发现的是水：原文说 Lin Wei sees water under the kitchen sink，接着说地板上有很多水。bowl 是她发现漏水之后放的；new pipe 是下午水管工修理时装的，不能混淆事件先后。
questions.evidence: On Monday morning, Lin Wei sees water under the kitchen sink. There is a lot of water on the floor.

questions.prompt: Is there any water near the electric socket?
questions.explanation: 原文中Lin Wei说“No, there isn't any water there.”，明确否定。
questions.evidence: "Yes. Is there any water near the electric socket?" Lin Wei looks. "No, there isn't any water there. But there is some water near the fridge."

questions.prompt: What time can the plumber come?
questions.explanation: 办公室的人说“A plumber can come at 2 p.m.”，时间是2 p.m.。
questions.evidence: A plumber can come at 2 p.m.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the sink?
options: There is a problem with the tap.
There is a small hole in the pipe.
answers: There is a small hole in the pipe.
questions.explanation: Tom说“There is a small hole in the pipe.”，问题在管道上。
questions.evidence: "There is a small hole in the pipe," he says. "There isn't any problem with the tap."

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: Tom puts a new ______ under the sink.
questions.explanation: 原文说“He puts a new pipe under the sink.”，填入pipe。
questions.evidence: He puts a new pipe under the sink.

questions.prompt: After Tom cleans the floor, is there any water on the floor?
questions.explanation: Tom说“No, there isn't. The floor is dry.”，所以没有水。
questions.evidence: No, there isn't. The floor is dry.

vocabulary.example: Lin Wei lives in a small flat at Maple Court.
On Monday morning, Lin Wei sees water under the kitchen sink.

But there is some water near the fridge.

grammar.title: there be 句型；可数与不可数名词；some / any；地点介词复习
grammar.explanation: 英语用“There is + 单数/不可数名词”表示“有某个东西”，用“There are + 复数名词”表示“有多个东西”。可数名词有单复数，如a window, two windows；不可数名词没有复数，如water, money。肯定句常用some，否定句和疑问句常用any。地点介词如under（在……下面）、near（在……附近）、in（在……里面）、on（在……上面）用来表示位置。注意：There is some water.（肯定）There isn't any water.（否定）Is there any water?（疑问）
grammar.example: There is a lot of water on the floor.

questions.prompt: There ______ a book on the table.
questions.explanation: a book是单数，所以用There is。
questions.evidence: There is a book on the table.

questions.prompt: There ______ two chairs in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: two chairs是复数，所以用There are。
questions.evidence: There are two chairs in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: 表示“冰箱里没有牛奶”的普通否定句：There isn't ______ milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 这里表示完全没有牛奶，普通否定句通常用 any。some 不是在所有否定句里都错误，但部分否定、对比等其他语境不是本题意思。
questions.evidence: There isn't any milk in the fridge.

questions.prompt: 你不知道瓶子里是否还有水，作中性询问，通常选哪个词？Is there ______ water in the bottle?
questions.explanation: 本题是没有预设答案的普通询问，通常用 any。some 也能出现在希望得到肯定回答等问句中，不能概括为疑问句永远不用 some。
questions.evidence: Is there any water in the bottle?

questions.prompt: There are ______ apples on the plate.
questions.evidence: There are some apples on the plate.

questions.prompt: 选择表示中文“在……下面”的介词：The cat is ______ the table.
questions.explanation: 题目明确要求“在……下面”，用 under。on 表示在上面，in 表示在里面；不能只看一个缺少位置线索的英文句子就猜猫在哪。
questions.evidence: The cat is under the table.

questions.prompt: There ______ any people in the room.
questions.evidence: There aren't any people in the room.

questions.prompt: 选择表示中文“在……附近”的介词：There is a lamp ______ the bed.
questions.explanation: 题目要求表示“在……附近”，选 near。under 是在下面，on 是在上面，二者不表达这里指定的中文意思。
questions.evidence: There is a lamp near the bed.
